name: Architecture Review
description: Assess architecture and produce source-grounded options, tradeoffs, and a durable decision record.
approval_boundaries: Do not implement the reviewed design unless separately authorized.
Escalate missing ownership or incompatible constraints.

phases.name: Architecture context
phases.instructions: Map relevant modules, callers, constraints, and decision scope.

phases.name: Source analysis
phases.instructions: Ground claims in code, tests, schemas, and existing decisions.

phases.name: Architecture review
phases.instructions: Compare viable options and assess coupling, cohesion, data flow, and scalability.

phases.name: Trust-boundary review
phases.instructions: When relevant, assess changes to trust boundaries and data exposure.

phases.name: Decision record
phases.instructions: Document the decision, alternatives, consequences, validation, and follow-up.
